pages.title: Gnome Deep
pages.creator: ApriCate Studio
pages.description: Dig beneath an oak stump for the Gnome King's lost treasure in Gnome Deep. Decide how much noise to make as you dig, since faster progress also attracts pests to the burrow.

pages.title: Patient Zero: Escape
pages.creator: Negru Gabriel
pages.description: Fit the shapes into empty spaces on each hospital board in Patient Zero: Escape. Work out where the pieces belong as you clear the puzzles on your patient form.

pages.title: Duck Family Simulator Animal Games
pages.creator: CodesXpirit
pages.description: Explore lakes, islands and forests as a wild duck in Duck Family Simulator Animal Games. Raise your family and keep watch for predators as you move through its different habitats.

pages.title: 2048 Sort Factory
pages.creator: Crazy Pixel
pages.description: Sort moving crates by number in 2048 Sort Factory. Get each one into the matching conveyor lane before it reaches the end, and try to finish each level with three stars.

pages.title: Battle Shot Elite
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Move into position and take aim in Battle Shot Elite. Switch weapons or use a grenade when the fight calls for it, and collect rewards as you work through the battles.

pages.title: Screwdom 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Dismantle 3D objects in Screwdom 3D by removing coins from their slots. Think about which pieces are in the way and collect gold for decorating your house.

pages.title: Blocks and that's it
pages.creator: Big Game Freaks
pages.description: Drag pieces onto an eight-by-eight grid in Blocks and that's it. Clear complete lines, and look for a placement that clears more than one at a time for a combo.

pages.title: Formula Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Steer Formula 1 cars through busy highways in Formula Traffic Racer. Choose among six cars and try three modes as you look for openings in traffic without crashing.

pages.title: AOD - Art Of Defense
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Plan your defenses in AOD - Art Of Defense by placing towers along the path of incoming enemies. Decide where your coverage needs to be strongest as each new wave approaches.

pages.title: Minecraft Pixel Warfare
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight other players in block-built arenas in Minecraft Pixel Warfare. Use firearms, grenades or close-range weapons and choose a mode such as Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag or free-for-all.

pages.title: Rocket Sky!
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Hold to send your rocket upward in Rocket Sky! and release before it overheats. Upgrade the rocket between launches to see how high you can go and which planets you can reach.

pages.title: Run from Baba Yaga
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Gather treasure while running from a witch in Run from Baba Yaga. Keep ahead of her as the chase speeds up and see how much you can collect along the route.

pages.title: Obby Survive Parkour
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Run through 3D obstacle courses in Obby Survive Parkour. Keep your balance over narrow sections and time your jumps to get past the hazards that appear along the escape route.

pages.title: Art Salon
pages.creator: Mad Pixel Games LTD
pages.description: Experiment with makeup and nail art in Art Salon. Choose colors for the look you want, then try out different designs and details on the acrylic nails.

pages.title: Emoji Smasher - Smiley Game
pages.creator: ChennaiGames Studio Private Limited
pages.description: Tap the sad and angry faces in Emoji Smasher - Smiley Game. Look at the expression before you react, and pick out the right emojis as they keep appearing.

pages.title: Kick and Ride
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Arrange blocks to make a path in Kick and Ride. Switch between puzzles that send a football toward its goal and layouts that need a route for a vehicle.

pages.title: Mona Lisa Fashion Experiments
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Try contemporary looks on a famous portrait in Mona Lisa Fashion Experiments. Play with modern trends and humorous combinations to see how each change alters her familiar appearance.

pages.title: School Teacher Game School Day
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Run a classroom in School Teacher Game School Day. Prepare lessons, grade work and interact with students as you move through the different parts of a teacher's day.

pages.title: Hero Story - Monsters Crossing
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Build bridges over gaps in Hero Story - Monsters Crossing. Judge the length before crossing and save tools such as Attack, Accurate Eye and Second Chance for when they help you most.

pages.title: Unblocked Motocross Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race other motocross riders along wooded routes in Unblocked Motocross Racing. Guide the bike over forest obstacles and choose when to build speed as the terrain changes.

pages.title: City Bus Parking Simulator Challenge 3D
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Drive a bus into designated spots in City Bus Parking Simulator Challenge 3D. Pay attention to the vehicle's length through each turn and position it carefully in the available space.

pages.title: Vex 8
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Run, jump and slide through nine Acts in Vex 8. Watch for red-green light traps and check around the main route for hidden areas as you progress.

pages.title: Car Puzzle 3D
pages.creator: Devshifu Studio
pages.description: Move the parked vehicles in the right order in Car Puzzle 3D. Check which ones have room to leave and clear the blocked paths as the parking arrangements become more complicated.

pages.title: Easter Coloring Book
pages.creator: Ioan Dorneanu
pages.description: Pick a festive picture in Easter Coloring Book and fill it in with your own colors. Try different shades on the Easter scenes to make each finished drawing look different.

pages.title: Panda Legend
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear matching pieces to gain an advantage in battle in Panda Legend. Plan which combinations to make and improve your characters so they can take on tougher challenges.

pages.title: Skydom Reforged
pages.creator: The Pew Pew
pages.description: Swap pieces to form groups of three in Skydom Reforged. Work through puzzles in the sky kingdoms and try the different modes when you want a new way to play.

pages.title: Zodiac Runner
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pick a zodiac sign at the beginning of a run in Zodiac Runner. Steer toward items connected to that sign and navigate the platforms as you collect them.

pages.title: Scary Huggy Playtime
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Hide or keep moving as Huggy searches the house in Scary Huggy Playtime. Try different modes to see how the chase changes when you play from the other side.

pages.title: Stickman Temple Duel
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Battle through forty stages in the story mode of Stickman Temple Duel. Challenge a friend or a computer opponent when you want a separate duel outside the story.

pages.title: Supernoob Prison Easter
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Collect twelve eggs in each chapter of Supernoob Prison Easter. Guide the Supernoob around falling bombs and incoming arrows as you search the prison for the remaining eggs.

pages.title: Tile Master Puzzle
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Pick out matching tiles in Tile Master Puzzle and put three of a kind together. Look for pieces that uncover more of the layout so you can keep making triples.

pages.title: The Pyramid Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Work with a second player to explore tombs in The Pyramid Adventure. Collect diamonds, solve puzzles and complete sculptures to unlock doors, while using your weapons against the threats inside.

pages.title: Parking Fury 3D: Bounty Hunter
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Drive supercars through crowded streets in Parking Fury 3D: Bounty Hunter. Watch for traffic from both directions and bring each vehicle to its destination without crashing it.

pages.title: Squidly Game 123 Stop
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Hold to run toward the finish in Squidly Game 123 Stop. Stop moving as soon as the light turns red and try to reach the line before the other runners.

pages.title: Beach Restaurant
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Read each beachgoer's order and serve the right food in Beach Restaurant. Prepare dishes quickly enough for impatient customers while keeping the ingredients straight as orders come in.

pages.title: Princess Sweet Kawaii Fashion
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Put together an outfit for Princess Eliza in Princess Sweet Kawaii Fashion. Use pastel colors and anime-inspired details to try the kawaii styles she discovers on her trip to Japan.

pages.title: Atari Pong
pages.creator: Atari
pages.description: Move the paddle to return the ball in Atari Pong. Score when your opponent misses a return, and try to be the first player to reach eleven points.

pages.title: Kitty Scramble
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Swipe across letters to uncover words in Kitty Scramble. Use the clues to work through the board with the cat and ask for a hint when you can't see the next word.

pages.title: Animal Name
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Practice recognizing animals by name in Animal Name. Look at the choices on the screen and match the requested name to the animal you think it describes.

pages.title: Double Wedding Look
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Princess Mia and Bella get ready for their shared wedding day in Double Wedding Look. Choose a gown, accessories and makeup for each bride before the ceremony.

pages.title: Kids Numbers and Alphabets
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pop balloons to practice letters and numbers in Kids Numbers and Alphabets. Listen as the game says each letter or number aloud and match what you hear to what you see.

pages.title: School Day
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Try four school-themed activities in School Day. Use the mouse to work through the tasks in the mode you pick, then switch when you want something different to do.

pages.title: Car Racing Winter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Race against computer-controlled drivers on winter tracks in Car Racing Winter. Use the arrow keys to steer and spend the coins you earn after levels on different cars.

pages.title: Giraffe Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Start with the first giraffe picture in Giraffe Jigsaw and unlock new images as you finish. Work through twelve jigsaws and choose from three difficulties for each one.

pages.title: Cute Animals With Cars Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Compare two scenes of animals and cars in Cute Animals With Cars Difference. Look closely at the vehicles and the details around them to spot changes as you unlock new pictures.

pages.title: Helicopter Flying Adventures Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Fly a helicopter between tall city buildings in Helicopter Flying Adventures Game. Keep control in different flight scenarios and line up the aircraft when you reach a landing spot.

pages.title: Gladiator Wars Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over gladiator cards to find identical pictures in Gladiator Wars Memory. Use what you remember about previous flips to clear each of the four boards in fewer moves.

pages.title: Alien Robot Warrior Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Search pictures of robot warriors for hidden stars in Alien Robot Warrior Hidden. Check each part of the scene carefully so you can pick out the stars against the background.

pages.title: Coloring Kitty
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Color scenes from Kitty's life in Coloring Kitty. Choose colors for the character and the details around her as you work through the different drawings.

pages.title: Exxtroider
pages.creator: Nela´s games
pages.description: Move left and right to dodge enemy fire in Exxtroider. Use your laser against waves of incoming ships and try to keep enough lives to reach the later enemies.

pages.title: MotoCross Hero Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Pick one of eight motocross pictures in MotoCross Hero Coloring and give the rider and bike their own colors. Show the finished image once you're happy with it.

pages.title: Tricky Tap
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Watch the clock hand sweep around in Tricky Tap. Tap when the hand points at another clock to send a shot its way and keep clearing the clock targets.

pages.title: Who wore it better 2 new trends
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style two princesses for a fashion competition in Who wore it better 2 new trends. Give each one a different outfit and see how the two looks compare.

pages.title: Baby Room Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Compare two views of a nursery in Baby Room Differences. Look from one picture to the other and click the details that change in the room.

pages.title: Forest Survival
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Stay alive in a blocky forest in Forest Survival. Craft supplies, manage your inventory and fight threats while keeping up with what your character needs to eat and drink.

pages.title: Ball Jump Piano Tile
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Guide a bouncing ball down the rotating tower in Ball Jump Piano Tile. Watch the openings in each layer and time your moves to reach the next section.

pages.title: Adventurous Snake & Ladders
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Roll the dice and travel across three different boards in Adventurous Snake & Ladders. Use ladders to advance, watch out for snakes and see what other events change your route.

pages.title: Peugeot 208 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of the Peugeot 208 in Peugeot 208 Puzzle. Pick one of six car images and choose from four piece counts to make it easier or more involved.

pages.title: Laramie Picnic Dressup
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Get Shelly ready to meet her friends at a summer festival in Laramie Picnic Dressup. Choose her makeup and put together a casual look for the park.

pages.title: Pixel Hero Warfare
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Take a pixelated fighter into online matches in Pixel Hero Warfare. Try different weapons and look for useful angles around the blocky maps as you compete with other players.

pages.title: Tiger Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Drag scattered pieces into place in Tiger Jigsaw. Earn enough in the puzzles to open another tiger picture and use the shapes and markings to fit each scene together.

pages.title: Russian Drift Ride 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Drift through traffic in Russian Drift Ride 3D. Get a feel for how the car slides through a turn, score points as you drive and use them to buy other cars.

pages.title: Indian Tractor Farm Simulator
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Work fields and raise livestock in Indian Tractor Farm Simulator. Take on forestry jobs as well as crop harvests, and sell what you produce to develop the farm.

pages.title: Hard Life
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide a ragdoll through traps in Hard Life. Move carefully past hazards with the arrow keys, collect stars and use them to unlock different characters for the levels.

pages.title: Cut My Rope
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Cut ropes at the right moment in Cut My Rope. Look at what will happen when each rope gives way and use the resulting swings and drops to solve the puzzle.

pages.title: Kids Coloring Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a drawing in Kids Coloring Time and fill it with colors using the virtual brush. Work on one image at a time or switch pictures when you want a new subject.

pages.title: Brick Breaker
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Move the paddle beneath the returning ball in Brick Breaker and bounce it into the bricks. Pick up power-ups such as a wider paddle as you work through changing layouts.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Ruined Wedding
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help repair the wedding venue after a storm in Dotted Girl Ruined Wedding. Fix the broken window and plates, put the flowers back in place and get things ready for the ceremony.

pages.title: Pirates vs Zombies
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Shoot approaching zombies in Pirates vs Zombies. Use the mouse to line up your aim and keep clearing the enemies as they get closer to your position.

pages.title: MathPup Golf Addition
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Solve addition problems as you play through twenty golf holes in MathPup Golf Addition. Pick Beginner, Intermediate or Expert to practice at a level that suits you.

pages.title: Crazy Shoot Factory 2
pages.creator: Hack TheREALITY
pages.description: Fight in low gravity in Crazy Shoot Factory 2. Jump and glide across the space arena and use the extra airtime to move into position for first-person firefights.

pages.title: Deep Sea Fishing Mania
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take a penguin out fishing in Deep Sea Fishing Mania. Catch fish and other sea creatures and bring them back to add some life to its aquarium.

pages.title: Roll This Ball
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Slide wooden tiles to connect a track in Roll This Ball. Work around the pieces blocking the way and make a continuous route to the red goal for the steel ball.

pages.title: Archery Training
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Practice aiming a bow in Archery Training. Adjust your shots to reach the targets on different fields and see whether your scores move you up the rankings.

pages.title: Little Princess Puzzle Games
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Join the sisters for different activities in Little Princess Puzzle Games. Color pictures with Elsa or help Anna work through matching puzzles during their friendly competition.

pages.title: Skyscraper Run
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Run up the sides of buildings as a superhero in Skyscraper Run. Watch for dangers on the climb and switch sides when you need to get around them.

pages.title: Wothan Escape
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Help Wothan get out of a dungeon in Wothan Escape. Bounce from wall to wall, collect coins and stay clear of spikes on the way to the exit door.

pages.title: Piggy Bank Adventure
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Cut the ropes to drop coins into a piggy bank in Piggy Bank Adventure. Plan each fall and collect stars for bonus points across the 24 physics puzzles.

pages.title: Not Lush Collections
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style Jasmine in steampunk and grunge outfits in Not Lush Collections. Try elements of both fashion collections and mix in pieces that suit her everyday style.

pages.title: Smart Sudoku
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fill the blank squares in Smart Sudoku using the numbers already on the board. Work through the rows, columns and boxes until each contains the required digits without repeats.

pages.title: Sun Beams 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Click dark clouds away in Sun Beams 2 to help the sun shine. Look at how the clouds block its way and decide which ones to clear in each scene.

pages.title: Mini Pop Tarts: Sara's Cooking Class
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Follow Sara into the kitchen in Mini Pop Tarts: Sara's Cooking Class. Prepare the small pastries step by step and finish the breakfast treats once the ingredients are ready.

pages.title: Age of War
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Send troops across the battlefield in Age of War. Time your attacks and build up your side through different ages as you fight to take down the enemy base.

pages.title: Princess Cash Me Outside
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Give Mulan, Cinderella, Snow White and Tiana bold streetwear looks in Princess Cash Me Outside. Try different pieces on each princess to give the group four distinct outfits.

pages.title: Blonde Vs Readhead Fashion Show
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Style two contestants in Blonde Vs Readhead Fashion Show. Choose clothes and accessories for the blonde and the redhead, then see how their looks come together for the contest.
